TCD.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.

Priority sectors are named in the draft strategy; no sector AI tool is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that in October 2026 Chad held a workshop with the UN Economic Commission for Africa for a preliminary review of its draft National AI Strategy.

TCD.note: The AI for Good Lab-Tchad and its public computing are only sought from the ITU; the LIDIA research lab is an AI research centre, not a model, dataset or computing in service.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that in August 2026 about 60 officials and curriculum developers were trained, with UNESCO support, on using AI to modernise school curricula.

TCD.note: A planned backup at the national data centre is mentioned; no data centre facts are stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that in October 2026 Chad's government approved a National Data Governance Strategy.
Ecofin Agency reports that in August 2025 Chad launched, with ADETIC, ENASTIC and the UNESCO Chair, a programme to train 2,000 young people in AI fundamentals.
